title: Chapter 92 Are You Competing With Me For Treasures?
content:
Chapter 92 Are You Competing With Me For Treasures?

At this moment, Lu Daosheng could clearly feel that the other party was a strong man in the God-breaking Realm.

Moreover, he was at the peak of the God-breaking Realm.

Looking at the star fields on all sides, this kind of strength is almost invincible.

At least, this was the first time that Lu Daosheng saw the existence of this realm.

Such a strong man with unknown origin approached his daughter, and Lu Daosheng would definitely break the casserole to get to the bottom of it.

At this time, Yu Qingfeng and Jiang Bei also stared at Gongsun Yao with a serious look.

The two of them were already in the God Emperor Realm, one realm away from the God-breaking Realm, so the two of them knew more about Gongsun Yao's horror.

At this moment, as long as Gongsun Yao had a slight movement, they would attack instantly.

Even if they were defeated.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's question, Gongsun Yao's eyes surged with a throbbing, but then it was fleeting.

"My name is Gongsun Yao, and I'm Lu Xue's good friend."

Gongsun Yao looked at Lu Daosheng and said with a smile.

Hearing this answer, Lu Daosheng sneered.

Do you really think you are a good-tempered person?

Lu Daosheng was shocked, and the whole space suddenly changed strangely.

Seeing this, Gongsun Yao's face changed drastically, and she was about to take action.

However, the next moment, Lu Daosheng and Gongsun Yao disappeared instantly.

Seeing this, everyone in the deserted city was slightly stunned, and immediately felt relieved.

With the city lord taking action, there must be no problem.

After all, if even Lu Daosheng can't solve it, then there is no point for them to take action.

At this time, Lu Xue slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

Her father is finally back.

As early as the moment Gongsun Yao entered the city for the first time, she already knew that the other party was plotting something wrong.

What happened before was just a delaying tactic.

After all, the other party could easily enter the city, and I think he was not afraid of the means left by his father.

So if we were to confront the other party head-on under the circumstances at that time, the risk would be too great.

The best way at that time was to slow down the other party and wait for my father to come back and solve it personally.

And now, my father is finally back.

Lu Xue was slightly delighted in her heart, and then she looked at the few people my father had just brought back.

When she saw Luo Li next to Yu Qingfeng, Lu Xue was stunned for a moment. My father brought back a woman?

I have to say that Lu Xue's focus is very unique.

The next moment, Lu Xue stepped forward and smiled, "Hello."

Seeing Lu Xue, Yu Qingfeng and the others were stunned.

Just as they were about to speak, Wen Hong had already knelt down to Lu Xue with a plop.

"Your subordinate Wen Hong meets the young lady!"

Everyone:? !

Even Lu Xue was a little unresponsive.

"Uh, you, you get up."

"Thank you, young lady!"

Wen Hong said loudly, and then he got up.

He heard it clearly just now. The extremely beautiful woman in front of him called Lu Daosheng "Dad".

And the people in the city called Lu Daosheng "Lord of the City".

He immediately understood Lu Daosheng's identity.

Lu Daosheng is the owner of this city.

And the woman in front of him is the daughter of the city lord.

Now, his chance to show off has come. If he wants to stay in this city in the future, it is naturally necessary to please the daughter of the Lord of the City.

At this time, Yu Qingfeng also reacted, and then he bowed to Lu Xue and said, "Meet the lady."

Lu Xue nodded, and then looked straight at Luo Li beside Yu Qingfeng.

"Well, who is this girl?"

Looking at Lu Xue, Luo Li bowed slightly and said, "My little girl Luo Li, yes..."

Luo Li raised her eyebrows and looked at Yu Qingfeng beside her, her face slightly red, "I am Yu Qingfeng's wife."

Hearing this, Lu Xue felt a little relieved, it was not what she thought.

Then Lu Xue pulled Luo Li aside with a happy face and talked in private.

These days with Gongsun Yao, I was always worried.

The key is to pretend to be stupid, I am almost suffocated.

If Gongsun Yao knew Lu Xue's thoughts, she might directly say: You don't have to pretend to be stupid, you just need to restrain yourself.

Aside, seeing his wife and the daughter of the city lord like this, Yu Qingfeng was extremely happy.

And Jiang Bei's face was a little solemn.

Before meeting Lu Daosheng, he had never been defeated and often claimed to be invincible.

But now, it has only been a short time.

It turns out that I have always been a frog in the well, sitting in the well and looking at the sky.

Thinking of this, Jiang Bei made up his mind to make good use of the resources in this city and strive to make further progress as soon as possible.

At the same time, in a unique space somewhere.

Two figures are standing quietly in it.

It is not others, but Lu Daosheng and Gongsun Yao.

At this moment, Gongsun Yao stared at Lu Daosheng in front of her with a serious expression.

Just now, Lu Daosheng forced her here with his great magical power. Now, she can't run away even if she wants to.

But it's too late to regret now.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from the field.

"Now, you can tell the truth."

"Tell me, what is your purpose in coming to my deserted city to approach my daughter, and who are you?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Gongsun Yao, his face cold, and said word by word.

Hearing this, Gongsun Yao was silent for a moment, revealing an innocent expression.

"I, I really just happened to come to that city, and I didn't know that was your daughter."

Seeing that Gongsun Yao still didn't tell the truth.

Lu Daosheng shook his head, he didn't have much patience.

Then, Lu Daosheng raised his hand slightly, and in an instant, the whole space began to tremble.

The next moment, the terrifying pressure suddenly pressed on Gongsun Yao.

In just a moment, Gongsun Yao knelt directly on the ground, and blood kept flowing from the corners of her mouth.

Facing the terrifying pressure, Gongsun Yao had no power to resist.

"Ah!! You, you stop it!"

At this time, Gongsun Yao's body kept making a cracking sound, which was the sound of broken bones.

Obviously, she was about to be unable to bear it.

Because Lu Daosheng didn't hold back at all.

Hearing Gongsun Yao's words, Lu Daosheng's face was indifferent, "If you tell the truth, I'm interested in sparing your life, otherwise, then you go to die."

Hearing this, Gongsun Yao's face was extremely ugly.

She never thought that Lu Xue's father was such a terrifying strong man, and the key was that he was so cruel.

If she had known this, she would have changed her method.

At this time, Gongsun Yao still did not give in. The next moment, a hazy breath suddenly slowly overflowed from Gongsun Yao's body.

Suddenly, the pressure around Gongsun Yao was reduced, and Gongsun Yao's face gradually became a little red.

That was the breath of the treasure.

Then, Gongsun Yao stood up with difficulty, looking at Lu Daosheng with a provocative look.

That look seemed to say, no matter how strong you are, you still can't do anything to me.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng laughed.

At this moment, he also understood how Gongsun Yao ignored the restrictions he had set and easily entered the deserted city.

But what's the use.

Comparing treasures with me?

Sorry, I am not only stronger than you, but also have more treasures than you.

Lu Daosheng took out a seal out of thin air, and then, Lu Daosheng threw it casually into the void.

Boom!

Accompanied by a terrifying shock sound.

A huge character suddenly appeared in the void.

Zhen!

This seal, called the Heaven-Suppressing Seal, is a congenital-level treasure.

It is rumored that this seal is so powerful that it even suppressed the heavenly way of a world, so it was named the Heaven-Suppressing Seal.
